body.p: A mottled face. Two tents. In one tents, a man lives, his wife lives, their two children live. In the other tent, an old man lives with two wives. One autumn, the men of the two tents went hunting wild reindeer. After the men left, the elder wife of the old man went for water. On hew way back, she saw a half motley face from behind a mouldering stump. She got very scared. She ran to her friends and said: "Let us sleep in one tent, when I went for water now, I saw a motley face behind a stump." Their friends from the neighbouring tent said: "You are always lying, so now you have probably imagined it again, I will sleep in my tent." She lay down in her tent with her children. The old man's two wives are not sleeping, the younger one has hidden under the pillows, and the old one is waiting for the witch with a motley face outside the door with a sharp ax. Some time later a cry was heard from the neighbouring tent, then the cry disappeared. Heavy footsteps were heard outside. Some time later the head of this walking woman appeared in the doorway, she started to blow the fire, her head was twirling on two beds [from side to side]. The old woman, chopping with an axe, from head to toe. While doing this, she said: "You shit, blow the fire, blow the fire!" The men came in the morning. Women said: "A friend with children who didn't listen to us died." The old man said to his friend whose wife died: "Let's live together, how will you live alone?" They started to live together. The old man gave his younger wife to the man. They live well.
